field.rationale: Illustrative ~850 m crop window, 100% cropland in esa-worldcover 2021; not a property boundary.

crops.calendar_source: Gaiapus data/ingest/crops.REGISTRY fixed state calendar (hypothesis) — data/ingest/crops.py

soil.source: AD4 available-water class (Gaiapus hypothesis, not a soil survey)

weather.source: NASA POWER daily point, community AG (rain: IMERG_PRECTOT); ET0 FAO-56 Penman-Monteith

water_balance.method: FAO-56 Kc single crop coefficient, fixed root zone (hypothesis)

ndvi.source: NASA HLS v2 (L30/S30), Microsoft Planetary Computer; median NDVI of clear pixels (Fmask), >=65% clear coverage

forecast.source: Open-Meteo forecast API, model ecmwf_ifs025 (ECMWF IFS 0.25), UTC daily sums
forecast.method: FAO-56 bucket advanced with forecast rain and ET0. Storage spun up from sowing with NASA POWER until 2026-08-31, then Open-Meteo ecmwf_ifs025 past days until 2026-11-14.
